## Objective
- Reconcile resource inventory and map-rotation documentation with verified assets and `game.js` behavior; finish reviewing UI/docs changes, then commit and push safely to `main`.

## Requirements
- Keep character, health, stats, inventory, and map on the right; keep spells in the bottom bar.
- Preserve the map label and existing logic; do not make unapproved map changes.
- Do not restore the kill counter or victory condition.
- Distinguish extracted assets, app usage, and verification limits; do not imply full visual or mechanical fidelity.
- Do not change map-rotation behavior until the proposed map list is approved.
- Push changes to `main` regularly.

## Decisions
- No additional UI adjustment was justified by the latest visual inspection.
- AO Libre graphics do not establish UI or mechanical fidelity; the HTML/CSS interface is custom.
- Ullathorpe (1), Nix (34), Banderbill (59), Lindos (62), and Arena (272) remain an unapproved map proposal.
- Leave `game.js` map behavior unchanged: random map on startup, advance to the next manifest map after five kills, and select a random map excluding the current one on reset.
- Document actual behavior separately from the unapproved proposal for a mutually agreed map list and distinct starting maps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the “0/5 BAJAS” display while retaining map/arena state; did not change rotation logic.
- Kept four skills and two potions in one bottom-bar row; prior Chromium checks covered desktop and mobile layouts.
- Updated resource inventory, README, and project handoffs with corrected counts, behavior, proposal status, and verification limits.
- Reviewed the full UI/code and documentation diffs; verified map behavior against `game.js` and `assets/ao/maps.json`.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js` / `node --check dist/game.js` passed.

### Active
- Decide how to reconcile the branch with `origin/main`, then commit intended changes and push safely.

### Blocked
- `HEAD` and `origin/main` have diverged (`2 13` commits ahead/behind); pushing directly is not a fast-forward.
- Branch history relative to `origin/main` includes extensive `.omgithub` deletions (92 files, 6,333 deletions in the comparison); do not merge or push without carefully isolating intended product changes.
- Map-list approval remains pending; do not change map behavior.

## Next Move
1. Inspect fetched `origin/main` and current branch ancestry/diffs to identify a safe integration path that preserves unrelated `main` work.
2. Stage only the intended 12 modified files, run relevant checks and `git diff --check`, then commit.
3. Push using a safe fast-forward workflow; do not force-push.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing startup, five-kill rotation, and reset map-selection behavior.

- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `dist/index.html`, `dist/styles.css`, `dist/game.js`: UI changes and build copies.

## Important Context
- Current branch: `opencode/43626325039`; `HEAD` is `ea087797c8d16ddb900f6df4c07654e5e3f2c9ae`; 12 files remain modified and uncommitted.
- `origin/main` was `7a66551164f28f010bc3d3bd0ce2c83b705208f8` before the latest `git fetch origin main`; fetch completed, but no subsequent ancestry check was run.

## Objective
- Reconcile resource inventory and map-rotation documentation with verified assets and `game.js` behavior; commit and safely push intended changes to `main`.

## Requirements
- Keep character, health, stats, inventory, and map on the right; keep spells in the bottom bar.
- Preserve the map label and existing logic; do not make unapproved map changes.
- Do not restore the kill counter or victory condition.
- Distinguish extracted assets, app usage, and verification limits; do not imply full visual or mechanical fidelity.
- Do not change map-rotation behavior until the proposed map list is approved.
- Push changes to `main` regularly.

## Decisions
- No additional UI adjustment was justified by the latest visual inspection.
- AO Libre graphics do not establish UI or mechanical fidelity; the HTML/CSS interface is custom.
- Ullathorpe (1), Nix (34), Banderbill (59), Lindos (62), and Arena (272) remain an unapproved map proposal.
- Leave `game.js` map behavior unchanged: random map on startup, advance to the next manifest map after five kills, and select a random map excluding the current one on reset.
- Document actual behavior separately from the unapproved proposal for a mutually agreed map list and distinct starting maps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the “0/5 BAJAS” display while retaining map/arena state; did not change rotation logic.
- Kept four skills and two potions in one bottom-bar row; prior Chromium checks covered desktop and mobile layouts.
- Updated resource inventory, README, and project handoffs with corrected counts, behavior, proposal status, and verification limits.
- Reviewed UI/code and documentation diffs; verified map behavior against `game.js` and `assets/ao/maps.json`.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js` / `node --check dist/game.js` passed.
- Fetched `origin/main`; no post-fetch ancestry check has been run.

### Active
- Safely reconcile branch history with `origin/main`, then stage only intended changes, commit, and push without force.

### Blocked
- Before fetch, `HEAD` and `origin/main` had diverged (`2 13` commits ahead/behind); pushing directly was not a fast-forward.
- Branch history relative to `origin/main` includes extensive `.omgithub` deletions; avoid merging or pushing those unrelated deletions unintentionally.
- Map-list approval remains pending; do not change map behavior.

## Next Move
1. Check updated `origin/main` ancestry and diffs; identify a safe integration path that preserves unrelated `main` work.
2. Stage only the intended 12 modified files, run relevant checks and `git diff --check`, then commit.
3. Push using a safe fast-forward workflow; do not force-push.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing startup, five-kill rotation, and reset map-selection behavior.
- `assets/ao/maps.json`: Five-map manifest and spawn coordinates.
- `roadmap/inventario-recursos-ao.md`: Corrected resource inventory and verification limits.
- `README.md`: Updated resource counts and map behavior.
- `00_cerebro_loop/USER_REQUESTS.md`: Inventory and pending map-list approval request.
- `00_cerebro_loop/ROADMAP.md`: Map proposal and current task status.
- `00_cerebro_loop/HANDOFF.md`: Latest work notes and continuation context.
- `HANDOFF.md`: Root-level handoff; old inventory counts were corrected.
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `dist/index.html`, `dist/styles.css`, `dist/game.js`: UI changes and build copies.

## Important Context
- Current branch: `opencode/43626325039`; `HEAD` is `ea087797c8d16ddb900f6df4c07654e5e3f2c9ae`; 12 files remain modified and uncommitted.
- `origin/main` was `7a66551164f28f010bc3d3bd0ce2c83b705208f8` before the latest `git fetch origin main`; fetched successfully, but its updated hash and ancestry were not checked.
- `game.js`/`dist/game.js`, `index.html`/`dist/index.html`, and `styles.css`/`dist/styles.css` are not byte-identical.
- Some older handoff notes conflict about whether reference screenshots block visual comparison; newer notes say the gallery is sufficient and side-by-side comparison remains pending.

## Objective
- Reconcile resource inventory and map-rotation documentation with verified assets and `game.js` behavior; commit and safely push intended changes to `main`.

## Requirements
- Keep character, health, stats, inventory, and map on the right; keep spells in the bottom bar.
- Preserve the map label and existing logic; do not make unapproved map changes.
- Do not restore the kill counter or victory condition.
- Distinguish extracted assets, app usage, and verification limits; do not imply full visual or mechanical fidelity.
- Do not change map-rotation behavior until the proposed map list is approved.
- Push changes to `main` regularly.

## Decisions
- No additional UI adjustment was justified by the latest visual inspection.
- AO Libre graphics do not establish UI or mechanical fidelity; the HTML/CSS interface is custom.
- Ullathorpe (1), Nix (34), Banderbill (59), Lindos (62), and Arena (272) remain an unapproved map proposal.
- Leave `game.js` map behavior unchanged: random map on startup, advance to the next manifest map after five kills, and select a random map excluding the current one on reset.
- Document actual behavior separately from the unapproved proposal for a mutually agreed map list and distinct starting maps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the “0/5 BAJAS” display while retaining map/arena state; did not change rotation logic.
- Kept four skills and two potions in one bottom-bar row; prior Chromium checks covered desktop and mobile layouts.
- Updated resource inventory, README, and project handoffs with corrected counts, behavior, proposal status, and verification limits.
- Reviewed UI/code and documentation diffs; verified map behavior against `game.js` and `assets/ao/maps.json`.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js` / `node --check dist/game.js` passed.
- Fetched `origin/main` and checked ancestry/diffs.

### Active
- Find a safe integration path for the intended changes that preserves unrelated `main` work and avoids pushing unrelated branch-history changes.

### Blocked
- Current branch `opencode/43626325039` is two commits ahead and 13 behind `origin/main`; direct push is not fast-forward.
- Branch history includes unrelated `.github/workflows/opencode.yml` and `.omgithub` changes/deletion; avoid merging or pushing those changes unintentionally.
- Map-list approval remains pending; do not change map behavior.

## Next Move
1. Compare intended changes with `origin/main` and identify a safe way to apply only those changes without carrying unrelated branch history.
2. Stage only the intended 12 modified files, run relevant checks and `git diff --check`, then commit.
3. Push through a safe fast-forward workflow; do not force-push.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing startup, five-kill rotation, and reset map-selection behavior.
- `assets/ao/maps.json`: Five-map manifest and spawn coordinates.
- `roadmap/inventario-recursos-ao.md`: Corrected resource inventory and verification limits.
- `README.md`: Updated resource counts and map behavior.
- `00_cerebro_loop/USER_REQUESTS.md`: Inventory and pending map-list approval request.
- `00_cerebro_loop/ROADMAP.md`: Map proposal and current task status.
- `00_cerebro_loop/HANDOFF.md`: Latest work notes and continuation context.
- `HANDOFF.md`: Root-level handoff; old inventory counts were corrected.
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `dist/index.html`, `dist/styles.css`, `dist/game.js`: UI changes and build copies.

## Important Context
- Current branch: `opencode/43626325039`; `HEAD` is `ea087797c8d16ddb900f6df4c07654e5e3f2c9ae`; 12 files remain modified and uncommitted.
- `origin/main` is `7a66551164f28f010bc3d3bd0ce2c83b705208f8`; merge base is `1ee8604c35964c3f1596ea5e30cfb29f2027a641`.
- `git diff origin/main...HEAD` includes unrelated workflow and `.omgithub` changes; `git diff HEAD..origin/main` shows extensive `.omgithub` additions.
- `game.js`/`dist/game.js`, `index.html`/`dist/index.html`, and `styles.css`/`dist/styles.css` are not byte-identical.
- Some older handoff notes conflict about whether reference screenshots block visual comparison; newer notes say the gallery is sufficient and side-by-side comparison remains pending.
